scope: Pinned paired synthetic STOI/ESTOI comparison at a task-local protocol-shaped developer adapter boundary; no processor exposure, public metric, listener/quality/device/release claim

public_boundary.registration: none; this task adds no C provider, descriptor, registry entry, installed default, public catalog entry, CMake target or audio-bench metric
public_boundary.note: All code and reports are under docs/task-evidence/stoi-estoi/. The opt-in adapter is Python-only and never registers itself.

decision.basis: Only frozen synthetic STOI/ESTOI scores are available. No rights-cleared held-out inputs, listener protocol, independent reference adapter, device profile, scorer intake or release approval is cleared.

scorer_pins.crosscheck: crosscheck_vectors.json records 12 external pystoi 0.4.1 comparisons; exact recorded deltas only, no oracle or acceptance threshold

historical_context.use: historical source-reported CLN-12 screen; not reproduced, not an oracle

invariants: The comparison is paired synthetic developer evidence at 16 kHz mono; every variant reuses one clean target and one masker realization per item.

The canonical scorer is a deterministic no-dither port of the pinned pystoi 0.4.1 non-extended and extended algorithms. External pystoi is a recorded cross-check only, never a candidate oracle or acceptance threshold.
Three in-process regenerations and three cold-start run.py --report invocations must be byte-identical; no tolerance widening or provider substitution is used.
Missing, nonfinite and short controls are blocked, invalid and failed respectively; no missing result qualifies as a score.
No public API, ABI, default, registry, shared code, audio-bench metric, CMake target or installed behavior is changed.
No real-speech, corpus, listening, MOS, intelligibility, quality, device, pacing, deadline, release, public-benchmark or Tiny16 comparison claim is made.
blockers: Hosted CI on the exact implementation head.
Rights-cleared held-out inputs with pinned provenance and a declared protocol.
Independent approved reference adapter and permitted case manifest before any adverse Tiny16 comparison.
Scorer source/license intake for pystoi 0.4.1 and its runtime dependencies.
Release approval before any processor exposure.
reopening_conditions: Freeze rights-cleared matched inputs and a declared listener or metric protocol, then rerun the pinned paired comparison with independent review.
Complete scorer/license intake and hosted CI on the exact head.
Obtain S10/protocol clearance, an approved independent reference adapter and a permitted case manifest before any Tiny16 comparison.
Review exact-head evidence and obtain release approval before proposing any processor or default change.
